seats.name: BubbaCuckShremp
seats.why: Sold their own next 1st but still competing — Early picks they hold stay valuable.
seats.plain: They do not own their own soonest first-round pick, yet they are still trying to win. Any Early pick sitting on their roster is leverage, not junk.
seats.use: Do not lowball their Early picks. Offer win-now help; only buy their own-team 1st if they are quitting the race.

seats.name: ChiefGumby
seats.why: Projected Early finish with a rebuild team — selling the present for draft capital.
seats.plain: The race points Early (bad finish → good pick) and their team direction is rebuild/tank. They are shaping next year’s capital on purpose.
seats.use: Buy their aging stars cheap. Sell them young pieces and future picks — not win-now glue.

seats.name: ARae
seats.why: Holds a pile of firsts while the race is still Mid/Early.
seats.plain: They already control several first-round picks and the live race is not Late. Draft capital is the story more than this year’s trophy.
seats.use: Trade into their pick stack with proven players, or buy a single first if they need a win-now piece.

seats.name: TipsUp
seats.why: Starts soft on the scoreboard and climbs by season’s end.
seats.plain: History says they often sit mid/low after week 4, then finish higher. Patience and in-season adds are their pattern.
seats.use: Do not write them off in September. Mid-season player buys to them can stick.

seats.name: bigjberg
seats.why: Looks strong early most years, then slides down the final board.
seats.plain: In past seasons they often ranked high on points after week 4, then finished several spots worse. Hot Septembers here are a warning, not a crown.
seats.use: Do not pay peak price in October. Prefer deals that age well if their board cools.

rule.priority: proxy → tank → reload-on-early → hoarder → slow burn → fast fade → bubble (mid only) → race favorite → balanced
rule.bubble_gate: bubble_rate≥0.6 and proj 4–7 and owns own first
